items.title: AI Agent Governance on AWS: Block Agents, Prove EU AI Act Compliance
items.summary: I built a synthetic multi-agent loan crew on Amazon Bedrock and made Traccia hard-block a runaway agent, redact applicant PII across every sub-agent, and export EU AI Act audit evidence. Two of my three governance policies blocked nothing - and not because I misconfigured them. Why is the useful part.
